_readme: Storefront settings. Edit, then run: python3 storefront/build.py
name: Archive 88
description: Archive 88 makes a permanent collection of considered clothing: natural fibres, honest construction and fits that stay in the range season after season.
_shopify_domain_note: Set to your-store.myshopify.com and fill shopify_variant_ids in catalog.json to send the bag to Shopify checkout.

categories.title: Outerwear
categories.intro: Coats and jackets in wool, wax and gabardine. Built for weather, cut for years.

categories.title: Knitwear
categories.intro: Merino, lambswool and cashmere from mills that have spun for generations.

categories.title: Shirts
categories.intro: Oxford, poplin, flannel and linen. The shirts you reach for first.

categories.title: Trousers
categories.intro: Chinos, wool trousers and selvedge denim, sized by the waist.

categories.title: Jersey
categories.intro: Heavyweight tees and loopback sweats in organic cotton.

categories.title: Tailoring
categories.intro: Soft-shouldered jackets that dress up or down without trying.

gift_cards._note: SAMPLE terms: check validity period and wording against your policy before launch. shopify_variant_ids: {"email/100": 123, "post/100": 456} enables checkout handoff.
gift_cards.post_note: Printed on heavy card in a woven envelope. Free UK postage, dispatched in 1 to 2 working days.
gift_cards.email_note: Arrives in their inbox straight away, or on a date you choose.
gift_cards.terms: Spend online across the whole collection. Use it in one go or over several orders.
